notes: «سمعت أبي العباس يحدث»: «أبي» plus name is one link, surface «العباس» (rule 7); «أبي» in «حدثنا أبي» is the father of Abdullah b. Muhammad (relation)
«مولى لبني مخزوم» is a client descriptor, not written as a link; surface «قمار»
«فحدثتني آمنة وقالت لي» gives Aminah as a source of part of the story (rule 5): last link; the soothsayer, Abd al-Muttalib and the others are in the story
«عن ابن عباس قال سمعت» : Ibn Abbas is a link, his father al-Abbas the last one above him
